pages.raw_meta: Expeditors is a Fortune 500 global logistics company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. Visit our website today.
raw_blocks: Global logistics excellence through rich industry expertise, best-in-class customer service, and leading-edge technology

Expeditors is a Fortune 500 service-based logistics company with headquarters in Bellevue, Washington, USA. At Expeditors, we generate highly optimized and customized supply chain solutions for our clients through unified technology systems integrated across a global network of over 335 locations in 100 countries on six continents.

As a service-based company, we don’t own the aircraft, ships, or trucks we use every day. This means we can be highly flexible in our approach to supply chain management and very effective at finding the best route and pricing options.
See key facts and figures about Expeditors
Our Culture and Core Values
At the core of our cultural philosophy is a mission to exceed customers’ expectations through excellence in global logistics. And we’re unwavering in our commitment to that mission.

Expeditors’ executives represent the most experienced logistics leadership team in the industry, and they stand as shining examples of our culture of long-term service and dependability.
Expeditors was founded in 1979 by true logistics visionaries.
Join us for a rewarding career with a dynamic, forward-thinking company.
We’re committed to the people and places where we live and work.

raw_blocks: At Expeditors, our technology is built to elevate your supply chain. With real-time visibility, predictive control, and actionable insight, you gain the clarity and confidence to move faster, plan smarter, and stay ahead across every shipment, lane, and region.
Network Optimization Tools help analyze your logistics network to identify cost-saving and service-enhancing opportunities through scenario modeling for sourcing, routing, and inventory placement.
Gain visibility into your carbon emissions with a centralized dashboard that tracks CO₂e output across transportation modes and regions.
Monitor performance over time, support ESG reporting requirements, and identify opportunities to reduce emissions while advancing your sustainability goals.
Our technology helps you gain end-to-end visibility across your supply chain, reduce risk with proactive alerts, and improve efficiency through automation and analytics.
With the insights needed to meet sustainability and compliance objectives, you can make smarter, more informed decisions with confidence.
